pairwise.reason: Submission Y is substantially superior across both models. For Rack A, while both follow the required dimensions and closed cabinet structure, Y features superior detail: realistic split side panels with latches, both leveling feet and casters, refined top cable-entry cutouts, and clearly distinct servers of varied heights with visible blanking panels and status LEDs glowing through the perforated door mesh. For Rack B, Y faithfully captures the reference photo (rack_open_frame_raised_floor.jpg) with slotted horizontal wire managers, accurately populated patch panels with properly dressed patch cords, vertical cable bundles, and authentic equipment spacing. In contrast, X's Rack B has unrealistic cabling (straight vertical lines passing arbitrarily through horizontal comb fingers without terminating into patch panels) and far less convincing hardware detail.
